At most 12 reviews matching the submission's current Impact Bridge map/reform are exposed after authoritative map/reform/artifact/source-version validation. Reviews require an improvement hypothesis, explicit uncertainty and provenance; eligible impact_review IDs are snapshot-bound and stale feedback fails closed. No parallel calculator or feedback store was created.
